meta.title: Candor
meta.description: Understand your data before you supplement. Pick a plan, chat first, and bring in a specialist when you need one.

hero.title:
See your health clearly —
start with a conversation.
hero.description:
Pick a one-month plan, then chat or upload labs.
Browsing is open; membership is required for a specialist or to keep your records.

chat.title: Consult
chat.placeholder: Tell me if you have a report, or what you want to tackle first…
chat.resetConfirm: Abandon this chat and start from the beginning?
chat.escalatedBody: Your name list goes to the advisor side. The consult happens on their system; this app does not show that conversation.
chat.escalatedLocked: AI replies are paused after handoff. Wait for the advisor side to follow up.
chat.guideAfterPackageConfirm: Plan confirmed. Keep going through the questions. If you have a recent checkup or blood test, choose Yes and you can upload the report. When it is ready, tap See recommended plan to build the month items and check out.
chat.guideUploadAfterQuiz: Questions done. If you have a recent lab report, upload it to compare numbers; then you can see the recommended plan and place an order.
chat.guideRecommendAfterQuiz: Questions and report are ready. Tap See recommended plan to confirm the month items and check out.
chat.guideUploadOnLabs: You can upload a report now to compare numbers, or tap Confirm to continue without a file.
chat.greet: Hi, I'm the Candor consult assistant. Do you already have a blood report, or do you want to look at the one-month plans first? When you're ready for a person, tap Talk to a specialist.
chat.greetBasic: You picked Basic: report reading. That path is for people who already have paper labs. Is this your latest report, and is there a number you want to look at first?
chat.greetMid: You picked Mid: assisted testing. If you don't have a report yet, we'll explain how collection is arranged. Are you more concerned about fatigue, metabolism, or a fuller panel?
chat.greetPremium: You picked Premium: personalized products. After payment you get a consult and keyed-in shipment. Do you already have a report, or do you need collection first?
chat.greetBasicCare: You picked Basic Care. Tell me if you have a blood report, or upload it — then you can see the chart and the one-month items.
chat.greetFullTune: You picked Full Tune, which is Basic Care plus extras. Tell me if you have a report, or upload labs first.
chat.reportReady: Report is ready — attaching to this chat…
chat.reportSkippedMismatch: This report’s patient details don’t match the sex/age from your answers, so it was skipped. We’ll continue from the goals you selected.
chat.goalsNeedTwo: Please pick at least two focus areas before confirming.
chat.reportFailed: Report processing failed. You can retry.
chat.reportNeedsReview: Report needs review. You can retry extraction.
chat.reportPollTimeout: Report is still processing. Try again later or re-upload.
chat.askInterpret: Please summarize this report in light of the goals I selected for this consult
chat.conversationError: Could not start the chat. Please refresh the page.
chat.streamError: Could not get a reply. Please try again.
chat.viewOnlyBody: This chat was saved when payment created the order. It is view-only — no editing or uploads.
